basic_steps: Maintain a constant bend in both knees throughout all steps.
Grasp the cloth belt (zonari) of the dancer on your left and right.
Execute the basic 8-step sequence spread over 12 counts while moving in an open circle.
When transitioning to tsestos, maintain the belt grip while accelerating footwork or stepping into an inner circle.
teaching.formation: Open circle or line holding adjacent dancers' belts (zonaria), led from the right.
teaching.level_notes: Beginners must maintain bent knees and a firm belt grip while keeping tempo with the open-circle movement.
